# HyperMesh 2019 boundary capture for the isolated curved strip probe
# (tools/audit_curved_strip_remesh.tcl, runtime/audit_curved_strip_remesh_19.000000.log).
# 9 quads on concentric rails R=97 (source) / R=100 (target), 10 degree steps,
# 3 mm gap.  *defaultremeshelems with all boundary nodes fixed split every one

# 0.366-0.377 mm off the chord (2.16% of chord length).  The attachment is
# preserved; the pre-2026-09 chord-collinearity check rejected it.
